name: How long does a professional night light installation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a professional night light installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation time for a bedroom night light varies based on the type of fixture and complexity. A simple plug-in unit requires no installation. Hardwired wall-mounted or recessed lights typically take 1-3 hours per fixture, especially if new wiring needs to be run or existing electrical boxes need modification. If multiple lights are being installed, or if the project involves extensive custom wiring, it could take a full day. We can provide a more precise estimate after an on-site consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time depends on the light type and complexity. Simple hardwired fixtures take 1-3 hours, while more complex projects may take a full day.
